verdict.rationale: Capsule's API is authenticated with a user's Bearer token, either generated in the account or obtained through OAuth 2. Nothing documents scopes, read-only tokens, or other least-privilege credential options. The only related control is per-user permissions ('Define what each user can see and edit'), which governs user roles, not credential scoping; creating a restricted user for an agent would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
